title: metadata: a bare unregister of an action name one package holds beside its package-less row names the host package, and leaves the removed row's stamped copy in the holder's slot (follow-up of #32791)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32791 (PR #32802). Reported by the card thread and confirmed by PR #32802's contract review (6835430791, the removal finding and N5). Older than #32560; not moved by PR #32802. Low priority; parked.

## What is wrong

Composition of #32791 (one package `com.alpha.app` holds the name in a stored row, a package-less stored row of the name saved last):

1. On a host declaring `com.host.app`, a bare `unregister('action', 'helper')` is refused `409` naming the host package and alpha, for all nine by-package types, on `296e2ec8`, `main` and PR #32802's head. `removalOf` checks `registryStore.has(key)` against the host's stamped slot.
2. On a host declaring the holder's package, a bare `unregister('action', 'helper')` deletes the package-less row from the table but leaves its stamped copy in the holder's registry slot. The bare read and the read naming that package keep answering the removed row (on `main` and PR #32802's head); before #32560 both rows and the slot went.

## Owed

Make bare removal agree with the bare read in these compositions (no phantom holder named; no stamped copy left behind), pinned red on `main` and green after, all nine types measured. This may be settled by the boot-pass card that withholds the host's stamp from a stored row (sibling follow-up of #32791); re-measure after it lands before writing new code.

Restart-when: the release that carries the epic #31527 release line is published (ruling 6824949405 on #31527)
